exam.exam_name: Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET - Lower Primary & Upper Primary)
exam.conducting_body: Directorate of Educational Research and Training (DERT), Shillong, Meghalaya
aliases: DERT Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test Examination

source_evidence.captured_wording: Upload recent passport size photograph (20 KB - 50 KB) and signature (10 KB - 20 KB) in JPG format.
source_evidence.document_title: Prospectus and Information Bulletin for Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET)

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG

spectacles.source_wording: Clear glasses permitted; dark glasses prohibited

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain white background; Frontal view with both ears visible
PDF; 100 KB to 300 KB PDF scan; A4 original document; NCTE recognized teacher education program completion certificate or final year appearing certificate

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Prospectus and Information Bulletin for Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET) - Section 7 (Application Procedures) (https://dert.meghalaya.gov.in/notices/MTET_Prospectus_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Prospectus and Information Bulletin for Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET) - Section 7 (Application Procedures) (https://dert.meghalaya.gov.in/notices/MTET_Prospectus_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
